title: Traffic Video Annotation for License Plate Detection
description: Annotated traffic video data for a computer vision dataset focused on vehicle and license plate detection.
objective: Create accurate, consistent video annotations suitable for training and evaluating computer vision models for vehicle and license plate detection.
steps: Reviewed the source traffic video and annotation requirements.
Used CVAT to annotate vehicles and license plates across video frames.
Created and reviewed bounding-box annotations for relevant objects.
Maintained consistent labels across sequential frames.
Performed quality checks for missing, inaccurate or inconsistent annotations.
results: Produced structured video annotations with consistent object labels and bounding boxes, while applying quality checks to improve dataset reliability.

challenges.problem: Objects can change position, scale and visibility across sequential video frames.
challenges.solution: Reviewed neighboring frames carefully and maintained consistent bounding-box placement and labels throughout the sequence.

dataset: Kaggle – License Plate Recognition for Red-Light Violation
